children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic is suing Google because they believe the Google Play Store is an unlawful monopoly.

> > Fact From Story: The upshot for consumers, Epic’s earlier legal filings have suggested, is that we pay higher prices for apps than we would if there were more competition and / or lower app store and payment processing fees.
> > > Fact From Story: Epic lead attorney Gary Bornstein was tasked with making the case that Android functions as an unlawful monopoly.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A lawyer would try to make a case that would be favorable to their client.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies that are not subject to competition are free to set prices as high as they believe consumers will pay.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Monopolies are illegal because they unfairly restrict competition.
